title: Find and Replace
h1: Find and Replace Text Online — Free Browser Tool
seoTitle: Find and Replace — Search and Replace Text Free
description: Search for plain text or a regular expression and replace matches in any block of text. Supports global replace and case options. Everything runs in your browser.
intro: Paste text, enter a search term or pattern, and replace every match instantly. Use it for cleaning data, fixing repeated typos or transforming lists without leaving the page.
blurb: Find and replace text or regex patterns in any block of text — free and private.

controls.label: Input text
controls.placeholder: Paste the text you want to edit...

howItWorks: Paste or type the text you want to modify into the input area.
Enter the text or regular expression to find, and the replacement string.
Optionally enable regular expression mode or case-insensitive matching, then press Replace.
Copy the result from the output box. All processing stays in your browser.
examples: Replace every occurrence of "color" with "colour" in a draft.
Use a regex to turn every date in YYYY-MM-DD format into DD/MM/YYYY.
Strip a common prefix from every line of a pasted list.

faq.q: Does the replacement support capture groups?
faq.a: Yes. When regular expression mode is on, you can use $1, $2 and so on in the replacement to insert captured groups.
No. The find-and-replace operation runs entirely inside your browser using ordinary JavaScript. Nothing is sent to a server.

faq.q: What happens with an invalid regular expression?
faq.a: The tool shows a clear error message and leaves the original text unchanged so you can fix the pattern.
